description: Performance Manager's declared dependency contract on the upstream Rill runtime. Rill is an EXTERNAL runtime owned, built and released by its upstream repository; this repository never compiles or natively tests Rill. This file pins the PM-side contract (protocol + capability + minimum version) and records the upstream release currently consumed. The upstream release entry is authoritative: when it is null/empty the integration is external-dependency-blocked and the Core capability gate reports it fail-closed.
versionRangeSemantics: runtime must satisfy protocol.api==2 and every required capability; higher unknown major is NOT assumed compatible; missing runtime, unreachable service or protocol-major mismatch is fail-closed.

upstream.blockedReason: no real upstream Rill release is provisioned yet; the previous in-repo Rill implementation was removed this cycle and no external upstream repository/release has been published. Integration is fail-closed until a real upstream release is pinned here.
